title: The Bug and The Hen
summary: A tiny bug sets out to warn a hen of danger, discovering that even the smallest creature can make a big difference.

pages.text: A bug sat in the mud.
pages.scene: A small red bug resting peacefully in warm earth

pages.text: A big dog ran and ran.
pages.scene: A large dog running fast through the garden, chasing a hen

pages.text: The hen! The hen was bad!
pages.scene: A frightened hen running from the dog

pages.text: The bug must go and help.
pages.scene: Bug deciding it must do something brave

pages.text: The bug hit the dog on the leg.
pages.scene: Tiny bug buzzing around dog's leg insistently

pages.text: The dog got mad and ran away.
pages.scene: Dog giving up chase and running off in frustration

pages.text: The hen sat and got a rest.
pages.scene: Hen sitting safely, catching its breath

pages.text: The bug was so brave and small.
pages.scene: Hen looking at tiny bug with gratitude and wonder

pages.text: We had fun and we are glad. The end.
pages.scene: Bug and hen together as friends, celebrating
